`θ_{t+1, ii} = θ_{t, ii} - (η / sqrt(G_{t-1, ii} + ε)) * g_t`

`θ_{t+1, ii} = θ_{t, ii} - (0.1 / 2.00000001) * 2`
`θ_{t+1, ii} = θ_{t, ii} - 0.099999998`
`θ_{t+1, ii} = θ_{t, ii} - 0.099999998`
